summary: The Issue #352 implementation conforms to the saved plan: the GitHub client fetches repo-level merge flags and base-branch pull_request ruleset allowed_merge_methods, the runner computes the effective intersection with squash preferred when allowed, passes an explicit allowed method to merge_pr, retries a method-disallowed rejection once with the next effective method, and records a merge-method NotifyHuman blocker when no allowed method remains or method resolution is unresolvable. Existing upstream-merged PR handling already short-circuits to ShortCircuitCompleted. Regression coverage now includes merge-only base rulesets, unconstrained squash defaults, no-alternative NotifyHuman escalation, retry-with-alternative success, ruleset empty/no-pull_request/omitted-method cases, intersection logic, rejection classification, and branch-rules error redaction. Focused validation evidence is recorded in plans/ISSUE_352_VALIDATION.md; broad AWF/GitHub validation remains owned by AWF after agent completion.
